name: Platform-cloudflare-cron-triggers lifecycle-event sink shape
purpose: The shape of every scheduled-side lifecycle event record. Bounds the event surface so a downstream logging companion never has to scrub PII or trim body bytes: every record is metadata-only by construction.
responsibilities: Constrain every record's keys to the allow-list {event, expression, scheduledTime, outcome, duration}; permit optional numeric fields {softBudgetMs, deltaMs} for cronStalled and cronSkewed respectively (AC-32106-1).
Never accept a handler input closure, PII field or body byte across the sink boundary; the dispatcher constructs records from event metadata only.

Provide the SIMULATE_PII_LEAK=true induced-failure switch on the event-secrecy probe: a wrapper sink that forwards a closure so a reviewer can prove the whitelist assertion is teeth-bearing on mutation.
internalStructure: The sink is a function reference (rec) => void injected into the dispatcher factory. In the local probes it is a spy that accumulates records; in a real project it is wired to the applied logging companion. The dispatcher module holds the whitelist knowledge; the sink is passive.

interfaces.name: eventSink parameter
interfaces.summary: Injected into createDispatcher; the dispatcher constructs records and calls the sink with each.
